notes.title: Update Ver 2.0
notes.content:
The following updates have been made to the game.

1.Three additional characters.

　Two additional regular characters and one rare character.


2.5-minute time attack mode added.

　A time attack mode has been added, in which users compete for records in five minutes.
　The score ranking is also separate from the normal ranking.

　If you cannot see the rankings in-game, please go to Steam's Community Hub -> View Data -> Global Rankings.
　Please switch to the normal ranking to display it as shown in the image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834994/3427daadf4e8bf731b65de68f95c814a99c7681c.jpg[/img]


3.Disappearing sushi bug resolved.

　A bug where only sushi dropped under certain conditions would disappear has been resolved.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.2
notes.content:
The following updates have been made to the game.

1.Addition of three rare characters

　The number of types of rare characters that appear at certain times has been increased by three.
　One is an ultra-rare character that only has an 8% chance of appearing.
　That character will receive a 3x score bonus. (other rares are doubled)


2. characters who have not appeared in the data personals are "?" Display.

　Characters who have not appeared in the main story are now displayed with a "?" in the character introduction.


3.Delay added when returning from options during the game.

　Fixed a problem where sushi would drop as soon as the options disappeared when returning from options by pressing the button with the right mouse button.


4.Added function to erase the result column when the game is over

　There was a request to see what the board looked like when the game was over, so a 'delete result' button was added.


5.Fixed a little problem with the judgment of suspicion.

　A bug that prevented the same sushi from changing even if they were in contact with each other has been resolved to some extent.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)



-Future updates planned.
1.More characters added.
2.Time attack mode (5 minutes) added.



-Under consideration
1.Steam achievements


-Not possible.
　I wanted to make it so that when you press X in the window, it gives you the option to quit the game or not, but I can't find a way to do that in unity visual scripting.


-etc.
Please do not touch the save data.
If you delete your save data and play, your Steam leaderboard score will be updated to what it was when you cleared the game.
I played with my personal save data while debugging and got fucked (1 loss).

notes.title: Mini-update Ver 1.1 & future plans
notes.content:
-The following changes have been made to the game.
1. changed the setting so that the cursor does not leave the window after the game starts.

　When opening another window during the game, use Alt+Tab to switch windows.
　To exit the game, click the Exit button in the title or press X in the window while using Alt+tab to switch windows.

　Because the cursor was not visible, there was a problem with unintentionally pressing the X on the window, causing it to exit.


2.Larger click notations in the options during the game.
　Problem with left-clicking the 'Close Options' button when returning in options during the game, which also causes sushi to drop. Right-click the button or use the ESC key to go back.
　
　I wish I could close the option and drop it after a bit, but it's not working a bit, so please keep it that way until it's resolved.


3.Other minor fixes
　Fixed that the frame did not appear when the cursor was hovered over the end button of the title.
　Fixed that the font of your rank in the ranking was not changed.



-Future updates planned.

1. addition of rare characters

2. adding a function to turn off the result screen and make the board visible during checkout.




-Defects.

1.Suspicion judgement.
　The same sushi is in contact with the same sushi but does not change.

2. disappearing material
　The moment the dropped sushi hits the same type of sushi, it disappears.

3.Score Ranking does not load
　I have confirmed that the score ranking does not load for some people.


　I would like to update 1 and 2 as soon as the problem can be resolved.

Regarding 3, we believe it may be a Steam setting, but at the moment the cause is unknown.
The transmission itself seems to be working, so please check in Steam's Community Hub -> View Data -> Global Ranking.



-Specification.

When the sushi is large and sometimes generated, it contains smaller sushi and shakes pulls, but it is a specification. Liveness.



-Under consideration

1. Steam achievements

2. time attack mode (5 or 10 minutes)
